Hi Priyom,

Hope you’re well — we’re getting Redwood set up in our AP system so we can process the upcoming PO (PO-0008743). Two quick asks from our end before our procurement team finalizes onboarding:

1) Confirm Redwood’s preferred remit-to (bank/EFT) details and what you put in the invoice remit section (we require a bank name + routing and beneficiary name).
2) Provide VAT/tax evidence or a self-cert form if applicable — we are in the US but some divisions require vendor tax classification for 1099 or VAT reciprocity when billing EU entities.

I’ve attached our vendor registration form (Omega_AP_vendor_form.pdf). Can you return it with an acceptable remit address and the invoice sample you plan to submit (PDF + machine-readable XML preferred)? We can then issue the PO and enable e-invoicing.

Targeting payment terms: Net 45 via EFT. If you need Net 30 or earlier payment, let us know and we can discuss a credit hold or early-pay program.

Thanks — would appreciate a response by Monday so our AP cutover stays on schedule.

Best,
Kelsey Martin

Hi Kelsey — thanks for the note and the form.

We can complete the vendor form and provide both a PDF invoice sample and the XML payload you mentioned. A few clarifications so we give you exactly what you need:

- Remit/EFT: Do you require a full ACH routing + account number on the vendor form, or is a bank name + treasury billing contact sufficient for initial onboarding? (We prefer sending account numbers over our secure portal.)

I’ll loop in our finance lead to confirm remit instructions and attach the requested docs.

Thanks for the ping. Answers below — I’ll draft the files you can return to Omega.

1) Remit/EFT: Standard practice is to provide bank name and "Remit via secure portal — ACH details provided upon portal registration/DocuSign" on publicly shared PDFs. For onboarding we’ll complete their PDF but redact full account numbers; instead attach a signed EFT mandate (PDF) via our secure transfer link. If they insist on account numbers in their form, we can provide them on a two-party redacted page to meet their format — but prefer the secure channel.

2) PO in XML: Most modern AP portals map PO to <OrderReference><ID> or <BuyerReference>, but to be safe include both in our sample. Provide XML with PO in <OrderReference><ID> and a second field <BuyerReference> with the same value. I’ll attach a sample XML (redwood_invoice_sample.xml) and a compact human-readable PDF.

3) Tax evidence: Send W-9 (PDF) for US tax status. Also include a short vendor-self-cert that states we are a US company, not VAT registered, and contact for any VAT-registered entity to request additional evidence. If they plan to route invoices to an EU entity, ask them which legal entity will be billed so we can provide the right tax docs.

I’ll prepare: completed Omega_AP_vendor_form.pdf (with remit language + secure portal note), W-9.pdf, redwood_invoice_sample.pdf, redwood_invoice_sample.xml. Marissa — can you sign the EFT mandate (encrypted) and upload to our SFTP?

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
